issues: Sheets 01-10: the map is a cropped, distorted black blob that bleeds off the left edge, with Canada cut off and Mexico squashed at the bottom. It does not read as a map of North America, and the lower 45 percent of the frame is empty.

Sheets 02-10: the labels point to the wrong places. 'SOUTHERN CANADA' sits at the tip of Mexico's peninsula, the 'UP TO 4,000 KM' leader line runs through the Gulf, and 'CENTRAL MEXICO' is placed above the map at the top, with a long red line crossing the title and the whole continent. The geography is wrong and the route cannot be traced.

Sheets 02-06: the straight red line from southern Canada to the south and the curved route line are two separate, conflicting paths. The route draws as a thin red line on a near-black land mass with very low contrast, so it is almost invisible on a phone, and it ends partway, short of Mexico.

Sheets 06-10: the CENTRAL MEXICO label collides with the MONARCH MIGRATION title (the leader line runs through the red title text), and the title is never removed, so the top of the frame is cluttered. UP TO 4,000 KM overlaps the leader line and later the yellow sticky note.

Sheets 07-08: the yellow sticker 'None of them has ever been there' covers the map labels and the route, and is placed on top of 'UP TO 4,000 KM' and 'SOUTHERN CANADA'. It appears at 13.7 s as a fade from a blank beige box. The key claim, no butterfly has made the trip before, is shown as a text overlay that fights the map rather than as a visual idea.

Sheets 09-10: the sticker swaps text to 'Their great-grandparents made the last trip' with a clumsy cross-fade (16.47 s, ghosted overlapping text), and it duplicates the caption. The bottom caption wraps to two lines and changes size between frames ('Their great-grandparents made' versus 'the last trip').

Sheets 01-02: the opening is a 1 s fade of a grey map, then a long static hold of the map with a title until 3.2 s, when the first route appears; the narration says 'fly south' at 2 to 4 s while nothing moves. No butterfly or other marker ever travels the route, so the motion does not carry the migration. Captions are small and drift in size (sheets 03, 05).
Sheet 10: the video ends on a static frame with white dots on the route that carry no clear meaning (generations are not labeled) and no resolved final state.
